model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between "Coverage" on the y-axis and the "Number of completions (k)" on the x-axis for four different model configurations. The entire plot is visually presented at an angled rotation. The x-axis utilizes a base-2 logarithmic scale, with labeled tick marks and extending vertical grid lines at every power of two ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$. The y-axis employs a linear scale with numeric labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The line for "Llama-3B" is a solid dark blue line with circular markers; it begins at $2^0$ with a coverage value of approximately 0.35, rises to a peak of 0.6 at $2^6$, and subsequently declines to end at 0.5 at $2^8$. The "Llama-3B + FT" configuration is depicted by a dotted dark green line with upward-pointing triangular markers; this line almost entirely overlaps the Llama-3B line, starting near 0.35 at $2^0$, peaking at 0.6 at $2^6$, and ending at 0.5 at $2^8$. The "Llama-1B" model is represented by a solid light blue line with circular markers, which starts at a lower initial coverage of roughly 0.2 at $2^0$, climbs steadily to peak just above the 0.4 grid line (approximately 0.42) at $2^7$, and dips slightly to finish on the 0.4 grid line at $2^8$. Finally, the "Llama-1B + FT" dotted light green line with upward-pointing triangular markers tracks the Llama-1B line very closely, beginning roughly at 0.2 at $2^0$, reaching a peak near 0.42 at $2^7$, and concluding at 0.4 at $2^8$.
